This aligns with the 'Implement the bounded mismatch reporter' task (slot 1), which took 118 minutes against an 80-minute budget (ratio 1.48). However, the new task is smaller in scope as it does not involve wiring the error envelope into the CLI or testing truncated tails, which were significant time sinks in the prior task. Assuming the core logic of the streaming tool is similar, the estimated time is reduced. The four acceptance cases are straightforward given the existing decoder setup.
